instructor: Prof. Dr. Abdul Hadi Mohammed Adkhil
subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: A fuzzy proposition truth value belongs to what?
questions.question_ar: قيمة صدق القضية الضبابية تنتمي إلى ماذا؟
options: the interval from zero to one
only the values zero or one
only values above one right here
options_en: the interval from zero to one
only the values zero or one
only values above one right here
questions.explanation: A fuzzy proposition can be true to any degree in the interval zero to one.
questions.explanation_ar: القضية الضبابية قد تكون صحيحة بأي درجة في المجال من صفر إلى واحد.

questions.question: How is fuzzy NOT computed?
questions.explanation: NOT subtracts the truth value from one.
questions.explanation_ar: النفي يطرح قيمة الصدق من الواحد، فيعكس الدرجة حول النصف.

questions.question: How is fuzzy implication computed?
options: the simple product of a and b
the simple sum of a and b
max of one minus a and b
min of one minus a and b
options_ar: حاصل ضرب a في b هنا
أقصى بين متمم a و b
أدنى بين متمم a و b
options_en: the simple product of a and b
the simple sum of a and b
max of one minus a and b
min of one minus a and b
questions.explanation: Implication takes the maximum of one minus a and b.
questions.explanation_ar: الاستلزام يأخذ أقصى قيمة بين واحد ناقص a و b.

questions.question: How is fuzzy equality computed?
options: the minimum of the two values
options_en: the minimum of the two values
questions.explanation: Equality is one minus the absolute difference of the two grades.
questions.explanation_ar: التساوي هو واحد ناقص الفرق المطلق بين الدرجتين.

questions.question: What is the canonical form of a fuzzy proposition?
options: v is F where F is fuzzy
F is v where v is crisp
v equals F for all values
F implies v for all values
options_ar: v هو F حيث F ضبابي
F هو v حيث v حاسم
options_en: v is F where F is fuzzy
F is v where v is crisp
v equals F for all values
F implies v for all values
questions.explanation: The canonical form is v is F, and its truth is the grade of v in F.
questions.explanation_ar: الصيغة القياسية v هو F، وصدقها درجة v في F.

questions.question: For OR between antecedents, how are the rule relations combined?
questions.question_ar: لعبارة OR بين المقدمات، كيف تُجمع علاقات القواعد؟
questions.explanation: OR combines the rule relations by union, AND by intersection.
questions.explanation_ar: OR يجمع علاقات القاعدة بالاتحاد، وAND بالتقاطع.

questions.question: Which two families of implication operators exist?
questions.explanation: There are operators coupling A with B and operators where A entails B.
questions.explanation_ar: توجد مشغلات تقترن فيها A بـ B ومشغلات تستلزم فيها A الـ B.

questions.question: When the antecedent grade is zero, what do entailment operators give?
questions.question_ar: عندما درجة المقدمة صفر، ماذا تعطي مشغلات الاستلزام؟
questions.explanation: A false premise makes an entailment vacuously true, so it gives one.
questions.explanation_ar: المقدمة الخاطئة تجعل الاستلزام صحيحاً تلقائياً، فيعطي واحداً.
